thesis: The episode explores the emerging agent stack, where founders are increasingly choosing to keep teams small by leveraging multiple agents to handle tasks previously done by larger product teams. It argues that this shift allows individuals to pursue their own projects and achieve their dreams even in a difficult job market, as building software costs approach zero.
